headline: Adani Ports shows consistent performance with strong revenue growth and disciplined leverage, though some long-term targets remain pending.

promises.promise: INR65,500 crores revenue and INR36,500 crores EBITDA by FY29
promises.quote: where we said we will be doing INR65,500 crores of revenue and INR36,500 crores of EBITDA
promises.evidence: Horizon is FY29, which has not been reached yet as of Sep 2026.

promises.promise: Revised full year guidance upwards by INR800 crores
promises.quote: we have revised our guidance by INR800 crores.
promises.evidence: FY26 revenue reached INR38,736 crores, showing strong growth.

promises.promise: Vizhinjam expansion will increase total capacity to 5.7 million TEUs
promises.quote: And so therefore, in total, we will go up to 5.7 million TEUs of total capacity.
promises.evidence: No subsequent definitive confirmation in later calls regarding the completion of this capacity.

promises.promise: Adani Logistics targeting roughly 11% double-digit growth
promises.quote: we are targeting double-digit growth as we have done even in this year, if you look at my year -on-year numbers, we are in double digits, roughly at 11%.
promises.evidence: Logistics revenue grew by 55% in FY '26.

promises.promise: Routine amortizations for repayments of INR3,500 crores in FY27
promises.quote: So in FY 27, we have only routine amortizations coming up for repayments, which is in the order of INR3,500 crores.
promises.evidence: FY27 has not concluded yet as of Sep 2026.

promises.quote: So with that story in mind, we keep the target of growing at CAGR of 18% to 19%.
promises.evidence: Long-term CAGR horizon has not ended.

promises.quote: Now moving forward, once again, our objective is to give you 20% return on capital employed as APSEZ level.
promises.evidence: The return on capital employed increased to 23% from 21%.

promises.promise: Guidance of 1 billion ton of cargo volume handled by 2030
promises.quote: Now we have given a guidance of 1 billion ton of cargo volume handled, which includes 850 million tons of domestic.
promises.evidence: Horizon is 2030, which is in the future.

promises.quote: And that's why we are saying that we are very comfortable even with the inflation that we will keep 70% and above the EBITDA margin
promises.evidence: Domestic ports maintained an EBITDA margin of 74%, but overall company OPM was around 58%-60%.

shifts.change: In Q3 FY26 leverage was kept under 1.8x, but in Q4 FY26 guidance perspective for net debt to EBITDA was set at 2.5x.
